'''Miho Asada''' (あさだみほ) is the creator of several [[Pokémon manga]]. She was born on May 7th in the {{wp|Hyogo Prefecture}}. She also created several ''Mega Man Battle Network'' and ''Yo-kai Watch'' manga.

==Pokémon manga by Miho Asada==
* [[Phantom Thief Pokémon 7]]
* [[Phantom Thief! Pokémon V]]
* [[Pokémon Battle Stories]]
* [[Pokémon: Yeah! I Got Pokémon!]]
* [[Pokémon Try Adventure]]
* [[Mobilize!! Pokémon Ranger]]
* [[Pokémon Battle: Pikachu's Big Exciting Adventure]]
* Lucario and the Mystery of Mew (Miho Asada version)
